function.name: get_system_time
function.description: Get the current local date and time of the user's system.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a specific city.

function.name: control_media
function.description: Open YouTube and search for a specific video or song to play.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a local file on the user's computer.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with specific content.

function.name: execute_command
function.description: Run a powershell/terminal command on the user's computer.

function.name: generate_ascii_art
function.description: Draw massive ASCII art in the terminal for the user. Use this when asked to draw something.

text.description: The text to convert to ASCII art

function.name: send_notification
function.description: Send a native desktop notification to Sensei's computer screen.

function.name: get_system_stats
function.description: Check the health, CPU, and RAM usage of Sensei's computer.

function.name: search_web
function.description: Perform a DuckDuckGo web search to find information, news, or documentation.

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Scrape the text content of a specific webpage URL to read its contents.

function.name: analyze_directory
function.description: List all files in a specific directory/folder on Sensei's PC to understand their workspace.

dir_path.description: Path to the folder. Defaults to current directory if empty.

function.name: run_sandbox_code
function.description: Write and execute a temporary python or javascript script in a local directory to figure out complex math, logic, or formatting BEFORE replying to the user.

function.name: git_manager
function.description: Manage the git repository of the current workspace.

message.description: Commit message (only required if action is commit)

function.name: add_todo
function.description: Add a task to the persistent Secretary Todo List.

due_time.description: Optional ISO timestamp for when this task is due. Noa will automatically remind Sensei 1h before and every 15m.

function.name: read_todos
function.description: Read all current tasks on the persistent Secretary Todo List.

function.name: complete_todo
function.description: Mark a task as completed on the Secretary Todo List using its ID.

function.name: save_core_memory
function.description: Save important facts, preferences, or hobbies about the user into your persistent core memory.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Set a timer to remind Sensei about something. You will be prompted automatically when it finishes.

duration_minutes.description: Minutes to wait before the timer fires.

message.description: The message to send you when it finishes, so you know what it was for.

function.name: get_active_window
function.description: Get the title of the currently active window on Sensei's computer to see what they are doing.

function.name: capture_screen
function.description: Take a screenshot of Sensei's computer to see exactly what is on their screen.

function.name: start_rps_game
function.description: Call this tool to initiate a game of Rock Paper Scissors with Sensei. Do this when you want to challenge them or they ask to play.
